problems: The Thirty-Eight Years' War page failed under the percent-encoded URL (%27) and loaded under the literal apostrophe; the cited URL is https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thirty-Eight_Years'_War.

Cliopatria's Chuzan row is spelled 'Chüzan' (slug chuzan); the shunten-dynasty dossier ends in 1314 at the Sanzan split, so the chuzan dossier (another jk-01 part) must link shunten-dynasty as predecessor and carry the Eiso kings Tamagusuku and Seii (1314-1349) with Satto's 1350 accession as a rename.

Transition years follow the pages (Asuka 538-710, Nara 710-794, Heian 794-1185, Kamakura 1185-1333, Northern Fujiwara 1087-1189) with one-year overlaps at each seam, as in the Tang example; Cliopatria's 540/709, 792/793, 1187/1188, 1094/1191 and 1332 are corrected in keyframe_review.
Counterparts 'emishi' and 'yamato' are used as slugs for states no row covers (see counterparts_needing_dossiers); the validator warns on them.

The Kamakura dossier's Mongol counterpart is 'mongol-empire' (Cliopatria row to 1293) although the pages name the Yuan dynasty; the East Asia group should carry the matching 1274-1281 contest. The Genko War counterpart is kenmu-restoration (1331-1333 contest).

sources_total counts unique pages opened (14); the per-dossier sources fields sum to 21 because the Emishi, Thirty-Eight Years' War, Gosannen, Northern Fujiwara and Genpei pages serve more than one dossier.
